preconditions.description: The length of the received string does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('0') and len(return_value) == 1 if return_value == '0' else not return_value.startswith('0')
postconditions.description: The restored number n has no leading zeroes unless it is zero itself.
The remembered substring is a part of the restored number n.

postconditions.expression: all(digit in '0123456789' for digit in return_value)
postconditions.description: The restored number n consists only of digits.
The last digit of the restored number n is the number of digits in the original number n.
